grover: Short follow-up from the INC-3245 postmortem. We need: a compact runbook fragment for cache-evictions during autoscale, explicit triage commands (copy-pasteable), PD escalation windows, and owners + deadlines. I sketched an actionable list below — please claim.

nina: I can take the runbook fragment and the checklist PR.

pat: I9ll own PagerDuty rules + a small integration test to reproduce the pattern.

grover: Minimal triage checklist (please paste verbatim into docs/incidents/cache-evictions.md):
1) evidence: collect pod events for evictions and OOMs: `kubectl -n infra get events --field-selector reason=Evicted --since=45m`
2) logs: `kubectl -n infra logs -l app=cache --tail=600 | egrep -i "evict|OOM|killed|oom"`
3) metric snapshot: `redwood-metrics query "sum(increase(redis_evictions[5m])) by (shard)"`
4) resource snapshot: `kubectl top pods -n infra --containers` + `kubectl describe node $NODE | egrep -i "Allocatable|Capacity|Non-terminated Pods"`
5) autoscaler trace: `kubectl -n kube-system logs deploy/cluster-autoscaler --since=2h | egrep -i "scale|no scale|failed"`
6) preserve: tar logs+metrics -> s3://redwood-incident-evidence/inc-3245/{{date}}/ and include README.md with commands run.

pat: Escalation proposal: page oncall after 1 eviction alert; if a second eviction occurs within 20m, escalate to infra lead and open an incident channel. I'll codify PD JSON and stage it.

runbook-bot: ACTION-9012 created: owner=nina due=2389009000

incidents-bot: ACTION-9013 created: owner=pat due=2389012000

nina: ACTION-9012: open PR docs/incidents/cache-evictions.md with the checklist above. Will include exact commands and example evidence README. Target: EOD today.

pat: ACTION-9013: add PD escalation policy + test in staging. Also add a play note: "if latency > 500ms and evictions increase, immediate mitigation is to scale cache by +2 replicas and consider temporary node cordon." Due by EOD tomorrow.

grover: Add a short triage snippet for oncall to run immediately when paged (copy to runbook):
```
# quick triage
kubectl -n infra logs -l app=cache --tail=300 | egrep -i "evict|oom"
redwood-metrics query "increase(redis_evictions[5m])"
kubectl top pods -n infra | sort -k3 -nr | head -n 10
```

oncall: Acknowledged. When paged I9ll run the quick triage, upload artifacts to the evidence bucket, and post links + timeline in the channel.

nina: PR note: please include ACTION-9012 in the PR body and link to INC-3245 so the dashboard aggregates.

pat: For the integration test I9ll script a bursty write pattern that ramps to target throughput and validates whether evictions occur; if reproducible, next step is autoscaler canary tuning (ACTION-9014).

runbook-bot: ACTION-9014 created: owner=pat due=2389070000

grover: Timeline check: if runbook PR and PD rule are not merged/deployed by the scheduled sync (Fri 10:30am), we escalate to the infra lead for resourcing.

nina: Opening PR in ~1h, tagging @pat and @grover, will paste ACTION-9012 in description.

incidents-bot: ACTION-9012 status: in_progress (owner: nina); ACTION-9013 status: in_progress (owner: pat); ACTION-9014 status: open (owner: pat).

grover: Thanks — scheduling a 15m follow-up Fri 10:30am to confirm runbook merged and PD rules live. If anyone needs a timeline shift, flag here by EOD today.

pat: noted, will report staging PD test results in this thread.

nina: Will add the evidence path pattern and an example README template to the PR.

incidents-bot: Thread linked to INC-3245 and ACTION-9012/9013/9014 for dashboard aggregation."
